storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature, away from damp. Use within a few months of opening.
looksLike: Flat, off-white, oval flakes that stay stiff when pressed; the thin ("patla") kind is papery.
howToPick: Buy "thick" or "jada" flakes that look whole and not powdery, with little broken dust at the bottom of the pack; a clean, mild smell. Avoid a musty smell or damp, clumped flakes.
shelfLife: Typically several months sealed (general guidance; not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 60 g per serving (about ¾ cup, dry thick poha)
